name: zero-suite
description: Zero (precision shooting log) and the Reloading Batch Tracker, over one shared Supabase backend.

scripts.build: npm run build:tracker && npm run build:zero
scripts.build:zero: npm run embed && esbuild apps/zero/entry.jsx --bundle --loader:.jsx=jsx --jsx=automatic --outfile=apps/zero/dist/bundle.js && node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('apps/zero/dist',{recursive:true});require('fs').copyFileSync('apps/zero/index.html','apps/zero/dist/index.html')"
scripts.test: node tools/embed-core.mjs --check && npm run test:core && npm run test:tracker && npm run test:zero
scripts.test:zero: cd apps/zero && node test-integration.mjs && node test-leaderboard.mjs && node test-relay.mjs
